Enerji derslerinin özellikle grada ve undergrada açılması gerektiğini düşünüyorum. Enerji üzerinden uluslararası ilişkileri, güç denge ve güvenlik politikalarını analiz etmek insana çok farklı bir bakış açısı katıyor. Grad seviyesinde akademik bakış açısı ile sahada aktif çalışan kişilerin tartışması çok farklı argümanların ortaya çıkmasını sağlıyor, çok daha eğitici ve verimli oluyor. instructor: Berk Esen is one of the most enthusiastic instructors I have ever met. He is passionate about all the topics being covered in class and is eager to explain them in a very comprehensive manner with interesting details and insights. The best thing about his class is that he makes his students think by actively encouraging students to participate in class and to make their comments. Since he could answer all questions being asked, people were motivated to ask their questions because they knew that they will most probably get a smart answer. His weak points, and I think he knows that himself, is that he is a very talkative person that is sometimes getting lost in the details when explaining certain issues (e.g. Russia's foreign policy regarding Europe is not necessarily relevant for understanding Turkish Foreign Policy). On the other hand, these details were mostly very interesting and gave some additional information that help students to get a better idea of the big picture.
